checkpoints.description: [1/2] Compute and independently audit exact conformal weights and quantum dimensions for the canonical SU(7)_1163 witnesses

impact_assessment.benefits: Supplies exact weights, numerical quantum dimensions and an ordering invariant for downstream model building, while keeping interpretation separate from measurement.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Pre-register exact weights 934/4095, 289/2730, 2/35 and quantum dimensions 1.136464998628996e11, 4.072382134390699e8, 4.568658409657278e5 in ADR-069; compute weights by exact integer Casimir arithmetic and dimensions by the Weyl q-dimension product; independently audit both; state that no mass relation is claimed.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new conformal-data checks and audit rows change fingerprints; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: none; state: source, tests, reports and docs; physics: quantum dimensions are not masses and no sector-to-mass mapping is established.
impact_assessment.why: Claims 66-70 establish a canonical host and canonical representatives, but no physical WZW invariant of those representatives has yet entered the ledger. Conformal weights and quantum dimensions are the next necessary data for any sector-dynamics model.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Test whether SU(7)_1163 can contain the Standard Model gauge WZW algebra as a conformal subalgebra using exact central charges

impact_assessment.benefits: Either identifies a necessary compatibility condition or rules out direct conformal embedding, clarifying that the phase sectors would need a coset/subsector interpretation.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Pre-register c_host=9304/195 and the strict SM gauge bound c<12 in ADR-070; compute exact rational central charges and compare by integer arithmetic; independently audit the inequality; avoid excluding coset or non-conformal constructions.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new central-charge checks and audit row change fingerprints; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: none; state: source, tests, reports and docs; physics: the WZW phase construction may not be intended as the SM gauge algebra, so the negative applies only to direct conformal embedding.
impact_assessment.why: Claim 71 supplies the canonical host's physical WZW data. The next model-selection constraint is whether its chiral algebra can directly contain the Standard Model gauge sector at equal central charge.

impact_assessment.why: Claim 72 excludes conformal SM embedding but not ordinary subgroup embedding. The standard 3+2+1+1 block decomposition of SU(7) provides a concrete non-conformal SM gauge subsector and a precise remaining coset.
